description: MuSiQue accuracy x throughput Pareto, v2 (2026-07-21): adds the RAG->memory hybrid, oracle-50, and SnapKV context-stuffing baselines to the 2026-07-19 systems. Judge Qwen3-4B, n=128, same corpora (inject_query_gold). Throughput: RAG/mem values from the 07-19 measured primitives; SnapKV measured directly (median wall-clock incl. per-query corpus re-streaming). SnapKV c2048 accuracy pending (run in flight).

mem_full_bank_hardneg750.source: 2026-07-19 pareto page (best-ladder throughput at matched bank)

hybrid_rag50_mem_hardneg750.note: throughput ~= mem decode floor at <=131k-slot scan + negligible retrieval; not separately measured

oracle50_mem_hardneg750.note: perfect-retrieval ceiling, not a deployable system point

snapkv_qwen3_4b.note: faithful question-conditioned streaming SnapKV; per-query corpus re-stream; c2048 stopped at 71/128 queries (unjudged partial preserved)
